title: Feedback drawer: list scrolls, comments and decision notes editable
author: builder
head: task-5-artifact-kit
body: The drawer's list could not scroll in the bare shell and its comments could not be changed. Make the drawer a fixed-height flex column with one scrolling body, and let readers edit or delete a comment and edit a decision's note or answer.

commits.subject: task-5: feedback drawer: list scrolls, comments and decision notes editable

comments.author: alex
comments.body: These fixed waits will flake when the machine is busy.
